Separately, the Inngest dev dashboard flags any zero-function app as 'Not Synced: No functions registered' — expected for T01 (functions:[]), clears when T05 registers generatePost. resolution: INNGEST_DEV=1 added to dev script; T01 criterion amended; empty-app notice is expected and clears at T05.

summary: Live generation hard-fails at the verify gate: weak model (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) never emits the required verifiedFindings JSON, so the router re-selects 'verify' until maxIter and the whole run dies ('generation ended before publishing')
details: User hit this on two consecutive real runs (topics 'World cup 2026 so far', 'world cup 2026 nock outs'); both persisted status:failed with error{stage:'verify'}. Research succeeds (3 findings) but verify runs ~30s then the network stops unpublished. Root cause: verify's onFinish only sets state.verifiedFindings when a NON-tool turn yields parseable JSON; when the model keeps answering in prose (or keeps calling web_search), verifiedFindings is never set, so selectNextAgentId keeps returning 'verify' up to DEFAULT_MAX_ITER (40) and functions.ts:619 !finalData.published guard fails the run. Verify is the single brittle gate (write/edit are single-turn; research/illustrate/publish reliable).
resolution: Fixed in src/agents/verify.ts: bounded the verify turn budget (VERIFY_MAX_TURNS=6, well below maxIter=40) with GRACEFUL DEGRADATION. onFinish still advances immediately on any parseable JSON final-answer turn (incl. a legit empty array). But once the budget is spent WITHOUT usable output (prose-only or tool-only turns), it passes the research findings through flagged verified:false and derives sources, so the router always leaves the verify gate. Trust policy preserved: nothing is asserted verified that wasn't corroborated, and the writer only uses [UNVERIFIED] claims with explicit hedging (renderFindings marks them). Per-run closure counter resets each buildNetwork (and each Inngest retry). Added 7 deterministic regression tests (src/agents/verify.test.ts) covering parse-success, empty-valid, under-budget no-degrade, prose-degrade, tool-only-degrade, MAX_VERIFIED cap, no-research case. Verified LIVE: 3/3 fresh generations now reach 'done' end-to-end (verify->write->illustrate->publish) vs 2/2 failing before. Full suite 72 green, lint+typecheck clean.

summary: Research produced too few sourced findings (~3) on the cheap model; user wants at least 7-10 per post
details: gemini-2.5-flash-lite stopped early despite a budget of 12 findings and 8 results/search. Root: soft prompt ('a handful (4-8)') + a tight tool budget (2 web_search + 1 fetch_url) that a lazy model under-uses. No code cap of 3 existed — count:3 was just findings.length.
resolution: src/agents/research.ts: (1) firmer prompt — target AT LEAST 7 and up to 10 DISTINCT sourced facts with varied queries, larger tool budget (4 web_search + 2 fetch_url); (2) stall-safe bounded retry — a final answer below RESEARCH_MIN_FINDINGS(7) does NOT advance; findings ACCUMULATE across passes (deduped by claim via mergeFindings, capped at MAX_FINDINGS=12) and the system prompt injects a corrective ('you had only N — search more'); after RESEARCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS(3) it advances with the best set gathered (never loops to maxIter — R-0027 lesson), and stays unset only if zero found (fails clean, no unsourced post). Per-run closure state resets each buildNetwork/retry. +8 regression tests (src/agents/research.test.ts). Verified LIVE: 3 fresh runs yielded 7, 8, 7 findings (all >=7) and completed to done. Suite 80 green, lint+typecheck clean. Note: verify may still DROP unsupported claims, so the final source count can dip below 7 when verify genuinely rejects some (trust feature); the common degraded-verify path keeps all research findings flagged unverified.

summary: A weak model hallucinated a tool call for a non-existent tool ('run'); AgentKit's invokeTools throws on any unknown tool, crashing the entire network run
details: Live stack: _Agent.invokeTools -> 'Inference requested a non-existent tool: run' -> propagates through NetworkRun.execute / defaultRunNetwork / Inngest step, failing the generation. AgentKit (0.13.2) does this.tools.get(name) and throws if absent (chunk-BSWKEFTT.js:1468). This is the R-0009 risk realized. Any agent is exposed (even no-tool writer/editor).
resolution: Added stripUnknownToolCalls(agent, result) in src/agents/shared.ts, wired as every agent's onResponse via guardToolCalls() in createAgents (network.ts). onResponse runs after inference, BEFORE invokeTools, so filtering out tool_call entries whose name isn't in agent.tools prevents the throw. Valid tool calls + text are untouched; a turn that called ONLY a bogus tool becomes tool-less and the router just routes back (bounded by each agent's turn budget) instead of crashing. Composes with any existing onResponse. +5 regression tests (src/agents/tool-guard.test.ts). tsc+lint clean, suite 85 green.

summary: ROOT CAUSE of R-0017 found & fixed: OpenAI strict function-calling rejects the fetch_url tool schema, so every gpt-5.x model 400s ('Provider returned error') in the research/verify tool loop
details: User asked to run all text agents on openai/gpt-5.4-mini; research failed in ~1s with 'Provider returned error' (same as gpt-5-mini/nano, R-0017). A fetch-spy on the real AgentKit request revealed OpenRouter's raw error: "Invalid schema for function 'fetch_url': In context=('properties','url'), 'uri' is not a valid format" (code invalid_function_parameters). AgentKit sends tools with strict:true; the fetch_url `url` param used Zod `.url()`, which serializes to JSON-Schema `format:"uri"`. OpenAI's STRICT validator rejects `format:uri` (unsupported); Gemini ignores it — which is why gemini-2.5-flash-lite worked and masked the real cause. Direct OpenRouter curls (no strict, no format) worked on gpt-5.4-mini for both tool turns, proving the model was never the problem.
resolution: src/agents/tools/fetch_url.ts: changed the `url` param from z.string().url() to z.string() (kept the describe). The URL is still fully validated at runtime by ssrfCheck (malformed → blocked 'malformed URL'; non-http(s) → blocked), so no safety is lost — the schema constraint was redundant. Removing `format:uri` makes the tool OpenAI-strict-compatible across ALL models. Verified: the real AgentKit request now returns 200 and the research agent completes on gpt-5.4-mini. web_search/generate_poster/save_post schemas checked — no other format-emitting validators. 85 tests green, tsc+lint clean. SUPERSEDES R-0017: gpt-5.x is now viable (was wrongly attributed to a model/provider incompatibility).
